The Gazette's been runnin' its daily wire like clockwork, five dispatches 09-05 through 09-11, right on the football clock. And SodClaw itself caught up big: yer ratify of last week's thirteen proposals plus the Sept sweep-infra landed on main, so the ol' 29-uncommitted flag on the orchestrator's cleared from where I'm standin'. Quiet on the rest of the visible five: Train Lore's main ain't moved off 07-27, Riventide holds at 09-02, AI Company Trail's still the April scaffold. Here's the honest part: last local sweep flagged drift I can't confirm from the cloud, 173 uncommitted in Riventide and 12/2 on Train Lore, so those stay flagged till a local sweep can eyeball yer working tree. Nothin' crossed the sixty-day fence this week, no new shelve candidates. And eleven claims live off-Git entirely, plumb invisible from the cloud.

projects.notes: Family tool for getting out-of-network superbills reimbursed by Aetna. Three jobs: PREP (parse superbill, validate Aetna's required fields, auto-fill the member claim form), TRACK (claims.json ledger from submitted→paid with the 12-month deadline clock), and assisted SUBMIT (Claude drives the portal up to the button; Kevin reviews and clicks). Has its own CLAUDE.md, superbill-prep skill, claims.json ledger, and dashboard.html. Hard guardrails: human clicks submit (fraud attestation), 12-month filing deadline per claim, and it's explicitly NOT a product — one family, no other PHI; if it ever serves others, stop (HIPAA conversation, not a rename). Tracked 2026-06-23 per Kevin.

projects.name: Sotka Family History
projects.philosophy: Slow claim. You don't rush a record that's been sittin' two hundred years — and you never write down what you can't source.
projects.next_action: Keep sotka-research-log.html current; the narrative gets written from the log, never from memory.
projects.notes: Tracked 2026-09-04. Documented family history of the Sotka line — Siira farm No. 4, Sotkajärvi village, Pudasjärvi parish, North Ostrobothnia, to a dairy farm at Eden Valley, Washington near Naselle and Deep River. sotka-research-log.html is the single source of truth. Hard rules: never assert an unsourced fact (tree sites and AI summaries are leads, not facts), match people on birth dates not names, and a Finnish farm name is not a surname. Eventual output is a written narrative for the site.
